about: Mutants of compiler/check/diag, the self-hosted checker's diagnostics (capstone S3, unit S3-DIAG). The agreement with the Go checker over the corpus, the negative fixtures and the seeded perturbations (TestCompilerUnusedAgreesWithChecker) kills each.

mutants.name: unused-read-ignored
mutants.rule: A local that a row reads is not unused.

mutants.name: unused-param-reported
mutants.rule: A parameter is read by its callers: never an unused local, also of a function literal a let holds.

mutants.name: unused-case-binding-reported
mutants.rule: A case's or a catch arm's binding has its own message (read nowhere in its arm), not the local's.

mutants.name: unused-let-skipped
mutants.rule: An unread let is an unused local.

mutants.name: unused-import-package-wide
mutants.rule: An import reaches only its own file: a read in another file of the package does not use it.

mutants.name: unused-missing-import-reported
mutants.rule: An import no package answers has its own diagnostic and counts as read.

mutants.name: unused-refused-alias-reported
mutants.rule: An import alias with no name clash is refused (S108) and counts as read.

mutants.name: unused-alias-clash-ignored
mutants.rule: An alias whose path's name is a package-level declaration's is needed: unread, it is an unused import.

mutants.name: unused-alias-at-path
mutants.rule: A named import is reported at its name (ImportSpec.Pos).

mutants.name: unused-unsorted
mutants.rule: Diagnostics are in the Go checker's order: by file, then offset (an import before a later local).

mutants.name: unused-message
mutants.rule: The message is the Go checker's text.

mutants.name: before-ignores-offset
mutants.rule: Within a file the order is by offset first.
